abstract: A case of seminoma in an abdominal testis is presented in which abnormal liver enzyme as well as elevated human chorionic gonadotropin levels were present which returned to normal after surgical extirpation of the primary lesion. A review of pertinent literature and implications of these unusual findings are presented.
abstract_ja: 腹腔内精巣のセミノーマの症例を報告する。異常な肝酵素および上昇したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン値が認められ、原発巣の外科的摘出後に正常化した。関連文献の検討とこれらの異常所見の意義について述べる。
